authorization: Root approved these values and rationale before any application comparison; raw Swiss provenance and tuples require root review before application execution.
purpose: Engineering product acceptance gates, not provider accuracy guarantees or a complete mathematical error envelope.

trueNode.definition: Traditional osculating ascending lunar node of the instantaneous lunar orbit; never substitute mean or interpolated node.
trueNode.directionPolicy: Require matching direct/retrograde direction only when BOTH the reference and application absolute longitude speeds exceed 0.02 degrees/day.
trueNode.rationale: The application and Swiss reference use the same broad osculating-plane definition with different lunar-state and velocity models. Swiss documents small JPL-versus-Swiss node differences, larger Moshier differences and substantially different interpolated-node values; none is a published complete error bound for this application's r-cross-v node or finite-difference speed. These conservative engineering gates must not be represented as such a bound.

polar.rationale: Retain the existing independent Swiss house/angle acceptance gates in src/lib/engine/engine.test.ts. Product whole-house fallback policy and Swiss Placidus error/Porphyry fallback status are evaluated separately from numeric parity.

failurePolicy: Preserve unexpected failures for diagnosis. Do not regenerate external expectations with the application or widen limits after observing residuals.
